title: Why shared attention vectors fail: a case for outcome-indexed tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dimensional attention in learning is often implemented as a globally shared attention vector, where each stimulus dimension corresponds to a single scalar. These scalars are learned by models through gradient-descent on error, where predictive features acquire more salience. We show that under multi-outcome learning, where models predict more than one outcome, this shared vector becomes unstable; it collapses to its bounds and prevents the models from learning meaningful attentional tunings for learning and generalization. We address this by introducing an outcome-indexed attentional matrix that converts globally shared attentional tuning into an outcome-indexed representation. We present an analysis of the unstable shared vectors and derive the conditions under which it holds. translated_title: 共享注意力向量为何失效：结果索引调优的论证
translated_abstract: 学习中的维度注意力通常被实现为全局共享的注意力向量，其中每个刺激维度对应一个标量。这些标量由模型通过对误差进行梯度下降来学习，具有预测性的特征会获得更高的显著性。我们表明，在多结果学习（即模型需要预测多个结果）的情况下，这种共享向量会变得不稳定；它会塌缩到其边界，从而阻止模型学习到对学习和泛化有意义的注意力调优。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种结果索引的注意力矩阵，将全局共享的注意力调优转换为结果索引的表示。我们对共享向量的不稳定性进行了分析，并推导出该现象成立的条件。在实证方面，三个合成实验对所提出的注意力矩阵进行了基准测试，结果表明它们能够收敛到有意义的表示，而这是共享注意力向量无法做到的。
tldr: 本文揭示了全局共享注意力向量在多结果学习中会不稳定并塌缩至边界的问题，并提出用结果索引的注意力矩阵替代，使其能收敛到对学习和泛化有意义的注意力表示。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that globally shared attention vectors become unstable and collapse to their bounds in multi-outcome learning, and proposes outcome-indexed attentional matrices that converge to meaningful representations for learning and generalization.
